lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.

Airlines canceled thousands of flights across the U.S. on Saturday as they worked to recover from a nationwide ground stop a day earlier that left passengers scrambling for seats and disrupted travel around the world, The Associated Press reports.
‘We are heartbroken’: Fifth soldier dies following CFB Wainwright fire, CTV News reports.
All 197 passengers and crew on the American Heritage cruise ship survived Friday as well as the crew on the tanker, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
